charts.name: lookup-latency
charts.title: Lookup wall time, warm, p50 of 20 (plan, plan + read, full scan, DuckDB)
charts.takeaway: Planning with the index and reading only the planned row groups beat a full scan in 0 of 42 lookups and DuckDB in 0 of 42; the plan alone (one bellwether process) took 83 ms at the median, of which 4 ms is starting any bellwether process.

charts.name: build
charts.title: Index build throughput by --threads, row groups per second
charts.takeaway: ledger-small went from 15 row groups per second on one thread to 18 on all (1.2x; best 18 at 8); market-10x went from 889 row groups per second on one thread to 2,189 on all (2.5x; best 2,189 at all); market-default went from 1,083 row groups per second on one thread to 1,516 on all (1.4x; best 1,677 at 4).

charts.name: reconcile
charts.title: Reconcile throughput by memory budget, rows per second per side
charts.takeaway: ledger-small compared 648,758 rows per second per side at 8 GiB and 330,455 at 64 MiB (10 passes); taxi compared 372,364 rows per second per side at 8 GiB and 22,737 at 64 MiB (224 passes).

charts.name: observe
charts.title: Observe tier (why, no workload) on replay-small, p50
charts.takeaway: Every way of asking why with no workload answered within 24 ms at the median, against the 100 ms observe budget (the CLI figure includes process start).
